# Print Shop Stack

> A directory of tools for running a 3D print business. Pricing comes from official vendor sites (checked 2026-10-20). No invented reviews.

## Print-Farm Software
- [Printago](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/printago/): Cloud print-farm management software that queues and dispatches jobs across many printers, including Bambu Lab machines.
- [SimplyPrint](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/simplyprint/): Browser-based printer management with remote control, print queues, cloud slicing, filament tracking and AI failure detection, across multiple printer brands.
- [OctoPrint](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/octoprint/): Open-source web interface for controlling and monitoring a single 3D printer, usually run on a Raspberry Pi, with a large plugin ecosystem.
- [Obico](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/obico/): AI-based print failure detection and remote access for OctoPrint and Klipper printers; open source, with a hosted cloud option or self-hosting.
- [3DPrinterOS](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/3dprinteros/): Cloud platform for managing fleets of 3D printers, aimed largely at schools, universities and enterprises.
- [AutoFarm3D (3DQue)](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/autofarm3d/): Print-farm software from 3DQue for queueing, monitoring and failure detection, which can run on a Raspberry Pi 4 for local, cloud-free remote access.

## Slicers
- [Bambu Studio](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/bambu-studio/): Bambu Lab's official slicer, with project files, multi-plate support, and device control for Bambu printers.
- [OrcaSlicer](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/orcaslicer/): Community open-source slicer forked from Bambu Studio, with calibration tools and profiles for many printer brands.
- [PrusaSlicer](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/prusaslicer/): Prusa Research's open-source slicer, with profiles for Prusa and many third-party printers.
- [UltiMaker Cura](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/cura/): UltiMaker's widely used slicer with a large library of printer profiles and plugins.

## AI 3D Model Generators
- [Meshy](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/meshy/): AI generator that turns text prompts or images into 3D models, with texturing, and has a 3D printing use case.
- [Tripo](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/tripo/): AI 3D model generator from text or images, with retopology and texture tools.
- [Hyper3D Rodin](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/rodin/): Hyper3D's Rodin generator creates 3D models from one or more images or text.

## Filament Brands
- [Bambu Lab Filament](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/bambu-filament/): Bambu Lab's own filament line, including RFID-tagged spools that Bambu AMS units read automatically.
- [Polymaker](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/polymaker/): Filament maker with a wide range, from PolyTerra/PolyLite PLA to engineering materials.
- [Elegoo Filament](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/elegoo/): Elegoo sells budget-oriented PLA and other filaments alongside its printers.
- [eSUN](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/esun/): Long-running filament manufacturer with PLA+, PETG and specialty materials.
- [Overture](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/overture/): Filament brand sold direct and on marketplaces, known for PLA and PETG lines.
- [SUNLU](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/sunlu/): Filament brand that also sells filament dryers.

## Etsy & Shopify Selling Tools
- [Etsy](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/etsy/): Marketplace for handmade and custom goods; a common first sales channel for 3D print shops.
- [Shopify](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/shopify/): Hosted e-commerce platform for running your own online store.
- [eRank](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/erank/): Etsy SEO and keyword research tool with listing audits and shop analytics.
- [Marmalead](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/marmalead/): Etsy SEO and keyword research tool.
- [EverBee](https://haydenyoung85-bit.github.io/printshop-stack/tools/everbee/): Etsy product research and analytics tool, with a Chrome extension and free calculators such as an Etsy fee calculator.
